name: Exa
desc: AI-powered search and content extraction from the web.

actions.name: get_contents
actions.description: Retrieve clean HTML content from specified URLs.

actions.name: generate_answer
actions.description: Provides direct answers to queries by summarizing results.

actions.name: perform_search
actions.description: Search the web using semantic or keyword-based search.

actions.name: find_similar_links
actions.description: Find pages similar to a given URL.

actions.name: exa_create_agent_run
actions.description: Starts an Exa Agent run for deep research, list building or structured extraction. The run works in the background; use Get Agent Run to read the result.

actions.name: exa_get_agent_run
actions.description: Gets the status and result of an Exa Agent run. Use it after Start Agent Run, for example behind a Delay step.

actions.name: exa_list_agent_runs
actions.description: Lists your team's Exa Agent runs, newest first, one page at a time.

actions.name: exa_cancel_agent_run
actions.description: Cancels a queued or running Exa Agent run right away. The run returns no results, and usage so far is still billed.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_search_monitor_results
triggers.description: Runs a search on a schedule and triggers with the new results Exa found since the last run.

guides.title: How to Set Up the Exa MCP Server for AI Search
guides.excerpt: The exa mcp server provides local AI agents with direct access to live web data. Developers can configure these tools to automate information retrieval.

guides.title: Exa automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Exa automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.

guides.title: How to Build an AI Agent Harness for Production
guides.excerpt: Agent infrastructure provides the technical guardrails required to prevent infinite loops and unauthorized system access during automated tasks.
